maps.name: Crypt of the Ashen Saint
maps.description: A small crypt beneath a ruined chapel: an entry hall, a hall of burial niches, a collapsed guardroom and, behind a locked iron door and a secret passage, the saint's warded tomb.

maps.name: The Flooded Chapel
maps.description: A sunken chapel half full of black water. Pews break the surface, the altar stands dry on its dais, and stairs in the east chapel descend into a drowned crypt.

maps.name: Forest Road Ambush
maps.description: A wagon lies overturned where the road narrows between oaks and pines. Bandits wait in the brush on both sides, and their camp sits in a ruined watch hut.

maps.name: Goblin Warren
maps.description: A goblin lair in a hillside cave: a ravine approach, a watch post by a fire, a den cut by an underground stream, a wolf pen, a glowing mushroom grotto and the chief's hall.

maps.name: The Rusty Flagon (ground floor)
maps.description: A busy roadside tavern: common room with bar and hearth, a private snug, a kitchen, a storeroom with a cellar trapdoor and a locked back door, all facing a cobbled street.

maps.name: The Rusty Flagon (upstairs)
maps.description: Upstairs at the Rusty Flagon: a landing hall, five rented rooms and the innkeeper's locked quarters.

maps.name: Wizard's Tower (middle floor)
maps.description: One round floor of a mage's tower: an outer ring split into a library-study and an alchemy lab, wrapped around a warded sanctum with a summoning circle behind a portcullis.

maps.name: The Greenhollow
maps.description: A small wood with a stream, a track and a clearing: a quick ambush or a camp at dusk.

maps.name: Brindle Cross
maps.description: A village on a river: houses along the roads, an inn and chapel on the green, fields and a bridge.

maps.name: Gullrock Shore
maps.description: Sea, surf and sand below the cliffs, with a fishing jetty and the land behind.

maps.name: Ironridge
maps.description: A road through a mountain pass, cliffs and scree above, pines lower down.

maps.name: The Drowned Canopy
maps.description: Deep rainforest cut by a brown river, with an overgrown step temple and an expedition camp.

maps.name: The Violet Hollow
maps.description: An alien grove of glowing mushroom towers, spore vents and crystal rings around violet pools. Dim light.

maps.name: Red Mesa
maps.description: A thousand feet of dunes and cracked flats, mesas, an oasis and buried ruins.

maps.name: Duskvale
maps.description: A whole land, one square a mile: sea, mountains, forests, rivers, towns and the roads between them.

rooms.name: Cave pool
rooms.description: A natural cave with a still pool and glowing mushrooms.

rooms.name: Collapsed hall
rooms.description: Half the ceiling is down: rubble, boulders and a narrow path.

rooms.name: Guard post
rooms.description: Bunks, a table and a weapon rack for 4 guards.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: Shelves along the walls, a reading desk and a lectern.

rooms.name: Mess hall
rooms.description: Long tables and a kitchen hearth.

rooms.name: Prison cells
rooms.description: Three barred cells off a guard walk.

rooms.name: Ritual chamber
rooms.description: A rune circle ringed by braziers.

rooms.name: Small shrine
rooms.description: A pillared shrine with an altar and candles. Two doorways, north and south.

rooms.name: Smithy
rooms.description: Forge, anvil and a rack of fresh blades.

rooms.name: Storeroom
rooms.description: Crates, barrels and sacks; good for hiding things.

rooms.name: Throne room
rooms.description: A long hall of pillars leading to a dais and throne.

rooms.name: Treasure vault
rooms.description: A locked vault with a chest, coins and a trap.
